pages.title: CLI Runtime and Command Registration
pages.purpose: Explain how the step binary boots, how urfave/cli is configured, how command packages self-register, orchestrate context/middleware, and how errors and panics are handled and debugged.
instructions: Describe boot sequence, cli.App wiring, global flags, STEPDEBUG behavior, panicHandler, password prompt injection, and the verify/lint help-quality checks.

pages.title: Plugin System
pages.purpose: Document how step discovers and executes external step-<name>-plugin executables and how well-known plugins are resolved/downloaded.
instructions: Explain LookPath resolution order over $(step path)/plugins and PATH, Windows power-shell handling, subprocess execution, and GetURL for well-known plugins.

pages.title: Token Model and JWT Claims
pages.purpose: Describe the JWT/one-time-token (OTT) model used to authorize step-ca operations: claim fields, token signing feature options, supported token types, and strict validity constraints.
instructions: Cover default claims, issuer/audience constants, With* option functions, cnf/x5c/nebula/sshpop headers, Type() discrimination across JWK/OIDC/GCP/AWS/Azure/K8sSA/Nebula, and validity bounds.

pages.title: Certificate and Token Flows
pages.purpose: Explain the reusable certificate/token/SSH flows that bridge CLI commands to step-ca, including per-provisioner token generation, offline vs online mode, and client construction.
instructions: Describe CertificateFlow methods (GenerateToken/GenerateSSHToken/Sign/CreateSignRequest), NewTokenFlow provisioner dispatch incl. ACME/SCEP errors, OfflineCA wrapper, and NewClient/AdminClient construction.

pages.title: Certificate Command Group
pages.purpose: Explain step certificate create/sign/inspect/verify/install and related helpers: profiles, templates, SANs, issuance flows, and local verification against roots/OCSP/CRL.
instructions: Cover create profiles and templates, key generation rules, bundle behavior, sign via CA certificate, verify (RFC5280/OCSP/CRL), inspect, install trust store.

pages.title: Configuration, Environment, and the Step Path
pages.purpose: Document step path resolution (STEPPATH), contexts for multi-CA environments, global --config handling, and key derivation of key-type defaults/flags.
instructions: Cover default $HOME/.step path and STEPPATH override, contexts.json, authority path behavior, --config flag, and default key type/curve/size resolution.

pages.title: KDF and Crypto Primitives
pages.purpose: Document the crypto command group and internal KDF helpers: scrypt/bcrypt/argon2 password hashing, key/CRL utilities, casts, and safe-default enforcement.
instructions: Cover KDF interface and PHC-encoded hashes, Compare semantics, cryptoutil signer/key loading incl. KMS, and CRL parse/creation used by certificate verify.

pages.title: Online and Offline step-ca Client Integration
pages.purpose: Document the client used to talk to step-ca and offline CA: CaClient interface, root/ca-url resolution, mTLS/admin client, trust store, and the ACME client/server flows.
instructions: Cover CaClient interface methods, NewClient offline/online selection, admin client mTLS, ACME standalone/webroot/device-attestation challenge modes, and acme-flow truststore option.

pages.title: SSH Certificate Integration
pages.purpose: Explain the SSH command group: certificate issuing, login/logout/inspect with the ssh-agent, proxycommand, rekey/renew/revoke, and the sshutil helpers.
instructions: Cover step ssh subcommands, agent usage, certificate parsing utilities, and how SSH sign tokens authorize certificate issuance.

pages.title: Testing Strategy and Integration Harness
pages.purpose: Explain how the repo is tested: unit tests, the testscript txtar integration harness, help-quality checks, and build/test/lint tooling.
instructions: Cover make target aliases (test/race/lint/bootstrap/build), gotestsum usage, testscript.Params with execute= step, txtar fixtures, and the help-quality report assertions.

pages.title: Quickstart
pages.purpose: Practical entry point for new users and engineers to build, install, and run representative step CLI workflows against both offline and online step-ca, plus environment/configuration basics.
instructions: Focus on reproducible quickstarts: building from source via Makefile, locating STEPS, using offline mode, bootstrapping an online CA, and common one-liner certificate/JWT/CA operations.
